main_text.p: eti[?]: Ignis lucet: calefacit:comburit stipulam & vstilia: purgat aurum & metalla. Sic Spiritus Sã-ctus illustrat mentes: Doctor veritatis: accen-dit amorem Dei & proximi: Diffusa est charitas Rom. 5. Convincit conscientias: electos convertens & purgans: reprobos inexcusabiles reddens: Arguet mundum,&c.
1. Cum sit ventus libere spirans: ergo Tyranni frustra se opponunt Evangelio.
II. Cum sit ignis: Non ergo Evangelium est litera mortua. Sed efficax organum Spiritus Sancti, contra Schwenckfeldium. Rom. 1. Evangelium potentia Dei. Jerem. 6. Faciam verba tua ignem,&c.
III. Cum his symbolis vere sit collatus Spiritus Sanctus: Deus ergo non ludit Ecclesiam symbolis,&c.
Explicetur de Baptismo & Cœna: Vere abluit fideles suo sanguine & spiritu: pascit suo corpore & sanguine juxta analogiam & promissionem symbolis annexam.

Refutetur calumnia de inanibus signis: Item, figmentum de conversione symbolorum, & latentia rerum in illis: per collationem locutionum Sacramentalium cum ista: Spiritus Sanctus sedit super unumquenque: Est ignis: columba: non cōversione:sed significatione Sacramentali.
Obiectio: Fuit essentialiter præsens in Symbolis: Ergo & corpus Christi substantialiter in pane: propter locutionum Sacramentalium similitudinem.

page.notes: Faint show-through of the reverse page is visible in the middle of the text block and was left out. The first word is clipped at the left edge of the printed line, so its first letter is doubtful. The Greek word "μερίσματα" is set at a small size and its final letters are uncertain. The numeral "1." may be printed as an Arabic 1 or as a lowercase i.
